The function renders the signature part (parameters + return annotation) and decides whether to use single-line or multi-line format.

```python
def render_signature(sig: inspect.Signature, max_line_len: Optional[int]=
    None, prefix: str='') ->str:
    # Render return annotation
    if sig.return_annotation is inspect.Signature.empty:
        return_str = ''
    else:
        return_str = ' -> ' + render_annotation(sig.return_annotation)
    
    # Render parameters
    params = [render_parameter(p) for p in sig.parameters.values()]
    
    # Try single-line first
    single_line = '(' + ', '.join(params) + ')' + return_str
    
    if max_line_len is None or len(single_line) <= max_line_len:
        return single_line
    
    # Multi-line format
    # Each parameter gets its own line with extra indentation
    inner_prefix = prefix + '    '
    if params:
        # All params except last get a comma
        param_lines = []
        for i, param in enumerate(params):
            if i < len(params) - 1:
                param_lines.append(inner_prefix + param + ',')
            else:
                param_lines.append(inner_prefix + param)
        params_str = '\n'.join(param_lines)
        multi_line = '(\n' + params_str + '\n' + prefix + ')' + return_str
    else:
        multi_line = '()' + return_str
    
    return multi_line
```
